frozen_case_identity.event_constraint: h0 = 0 cm with three conservative cell balances plus exact surface-storage balance

interpretation: Relaxing the A2 lower-node upper bound from -1 cm to -1e-8 cm does not reveal a reproducible conservative O14 root in any of the 24 frozen profile x supply cases.
Twelve deterministic starts per case, spanning four lower-node topology starts and three surface/time starts, do not rescue the isolated h0=0 event formulation.
Therefore the A2 O14 pathology is not adequately explained by one poor starting guess or by the former h1,h2<=-1 cm diagnostic bound.
This remains negative evidence about the isolated event formulation, not a falsification of Ross physics or of the already qualified surface-face flux law.

The next scientific question is whether the physically correct event is a coupled complementarity/co-event condition rather than an isolated top-node equality h0=0 imposed together with a strictly positive surface-storage unknown.
